title: Template function `getHostByName` removed (GHSA-r2pg-r6h7-crf3)
quote: fix: remove getHostByName from template funcs
remediation: Remove `getHostByName` from the templates of the ExternalSecrets named; the function was a DNS exfiltration path and templates calling it fail to render from 2.3.
verifyCommand: kubectl get externalsecrets.external-secrets.io,clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | (.spec.target.template // .spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template // {}) | tostring | select(test("getHostByName")) | $o | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row's template calls getHostByName
